_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
Smart Cuff v3.1.384 improves SysID identification under measured stable leakage.

- Qualify two steady sealed windows at each actual pressure band, then use that local activity threshold throughout discovery, gain fitting, independent repeats and evidence review. Closed-valve leakage cannot dilute gain. Feedforward retains total measured pressure decay.
- Correct the initial landing near85 mmHg before the full30-second sealed check. Keep the70-mmHg endpoint floor and0.85-mmHg/s hard decay limit. Missing, uncertain, changing or inconsistent evidence rejects adoption.
- Scout the freshly read closed-side upper valve limit, measure and re-measure it. A controlled active scout returns to90%; an uncontrolled scout aborts. Newly measured critical brackets keep fine precision, while interior spacing is bounded to2%.
- Give completed verified pressure restoration a separate180-second discovery allowance. Require fresh idle telemetry, pump off and finite comparable pressure before any credit. Mandatory5-second sealed support, post-probe evidence and bleeds retain the original260-second acquisition/support budget (360 LOW). Check both budgets before the next valve probe. If pressure falls below the comparison range during settling, make one measured correction capped190 (55 LOW), then repeat the original sealed checks. The reference/range remain unchanged; a failed correction rejects. Continuous exposure, recovery limits, local inflation watchdogs and quality gates remain active.

Validation:705 combined SysID, installer and workflow tests passed. Session-scoped Qt application ownership in the test fixture resolves the prior native callback crash. Synthetic measured leakage0.4–0.8 mmHg/s previously approximately halved a known0.5 valve gain; using the measured local floor recovers0.5. This is a software regression, not deliberately added physical leakage.

The measurement-only large-cuff comparison and all prior failed attempts are retained with raw serial and all3 native NI channels. No new tuning, device snapshot or fleet profile has been adopted. Run04 was intentionally operator-interrupted; its failed immediate readback remains alongside successful late verification. Requested2% in that run actually used1% and is not a validated2% comparison. Final run10 qualified local HIGH sealed decay around0.54 mmHg/s but failed comparable settled pressure after its one capped correction (147.81 versus164.09 mmHg). All10 attempts ended safe; before/after settings matched, with separately retained late verification for interrupted/delayed-readback attempts. Full large-cuff identification remains unqualified. The accepted saved tuning is retained. Final decisions and every raw signal are in the local study report.

Firmware remains rev27v-followup-351. Production PID, valve limits, PVR peak+5, Smart Const/High Max caps130/140 and fallback80 are unchanged. Source b65d164192129a30776eb8d0e0fc18147720c42c, default branch. Versions378–382 were not published.
